source.section: instructions PDF page 6, Schedule E Line 2A; Schedule E Lines 1, 3, 4A to 4H, 5 (Form IT-540 PDF page 8; instructions PDF pages 6, 7 and 10); Form IT-540 (PDF page 3) Lines 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13; instructions PDF page 3, Lines 7 to 13; rate: PDF page 1 What's New

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 50,000.00 = 50,000.00. Municipal interest is tax-exempt federally and not in federal AGI. Federal taxable income = 50,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 34,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Filing status 1 on Form IT-540. Louisiana starts from federal AGI. Schedule E: Line 1 federal AGI 50,000.00. Line 2A other-state interest 2,000.00 (purchased on or after January 1, 1980). Line 3 total = 52,000.00. Exempt income: none. Line 4H = 0.00. Line 5 Louisiana AGI = 52,000.00 - 0.00 = 52,000.00. IT-540 Line 7 (from Schedule E Line 5) 52,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction (filing status 1) 12,500.00. Lines 9A to 9D skipped (no federal itemizing). Line 10 = 52,000.00 - 12,500.00 = 39,500.00. Line 11 = 39,500.00 x .03 = 1,185.00. Line 12 credits 0.00. Line 13 = 1,185.00. The 3,000.00 of Louisiana bond interest is exempt and is not added on Line 2A.
